venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU — Philo from a clean pocket, Baugh when the hole moved
dek: Sat the 14 ESPN scoring-play clips plus the official SEC 80-second cut. Broadcast angle only. Not All-22. Not every snap. 66–21 stays on the schedule card. This board is the watch.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — broadcast scoring package sat (14 ESPN play clips + SEC highlight). Full YouTube condensed game was not sat end-to-end in this room. Not All-22. Charles has not approved publish. Fan rail stays empty.

sources.label: ESPN full-game highlights (sat via official play clips)
Official box (stats only — support after the snap)

headline: Philo threw it on time from shotgun. Baugh scored three different ways. The two FAU touchdowns we sat were a lost edge and a lost fade.

offense.body:
Florida lived in no-huddle shotgun on every scoring snap in this package. Aaron Philo (No. 12) had a clean pocket on the throws that hit the board.

Opening score, 8:41 of the first: Vernell Brown III (No. 1) turns a short-right catch into a 49-yard touchdown. Official chart has it caught at the FAU 50. On the broadcast you see Brown in the open around the FAU 40 with a white jersey on the ground behind him — missed tackle, then a footrace. That is not a jump-ball. That is YAC after the first man loses his feet.

Next trip, 6:28: Philo from the FAU 12, three-step, loft to the back pylon. Bailey Stockton (No. 3) wins the corner, high-points it, toe-taps the back line. FAU No. 8 is in his hip pocket and late. Zero YAC. That's a placed ball.

Red zone later, 11:02 of the second: 4th-and-goal from the 3, empty. FAU's edges climb the pocket and lose contain. Philo keeps right and walks it in. Chart calls it a 3-yard rush. On tape it is a quarterback who sees the void.

Jadan Baugh (No. 13) scored three times and they do not look the same. The 12-yarder at 4:05 of the second: shotgun, front side clogs, Baugh plants and cuts backside. FAU No. 20 whiffs the arm tackle. The Skycam replay shows the cut in the backfield; he is untouched the last five. The 7-yarder at 2:50: 2nd-and-3, the inside look clogs, Baugh bounces outside the left tackle, pad down through two arm tackles, dives the last yard. The 6-yarder at 13:08 of the third: 1st-and-goal, wing motion, power. A puller leads. Baugh is patient, then vertical, then through the pile at the 2.

Duke Clark (No. 20) is the closer. Ten-yard catch at 4:21 of the third — trips, drag, Philo steps up and throws a dart. Clark catches at the 2 and drives FAU No. 12 and No. 6 across the plane. Then the 4-yard rush at 12:24 of the fourth — gap look, puller, Clark finishes standing up. That is Baugh's complement, not a gadget.

What this package does not show: Abrams' 63, Baugh's 61-yarder that set up the 6-yard score, Jones-to-Jones late. Those are on the official chart. They are not on these clips. We are not inventing them. Philo's interception is not on this package either — we are not grading a throw we did not sit.
bullets: Philo: shotgun, clean pocket on the Brown / Stockton / Clark scoring throws; 4th-and-goal empty keep when the edges climb.
Brown III: short-right catch, missed tackle at the 40, 49-yard house call. Chart support: 6-117 after the Clark score.
Stockton: 12-yard back-pylon fade, toe-tap, FAU No. 8 trailing.
Baugh: 12-yard backside cut, 7-yard bounce-and-pad, 6-yard power through the puller.
Clark: drag-and-finish at the 2, then a 4-yard gap run standing up.
Not on this tape: Abrams 63, Baugh 61, Micah Jones. Do not write them as On Tape.

defense.kicker: Defense — takeaways we sat, and the two TDs against
defense.body:
The two takeaways in this package are real, and they are not the same play.

12:07 of the first, 0–0, 3rd-and-10: Caden Veltkamp (No. 10) from shotgun. DJ Coleman (No. 33) jumps the throwing lane, catches it on the hands, and the drive dies at the Florida 6. Chart: intercepted at the 5, return of a yard. Do not dress that up as a house call.

4:01 of the second, right after Baugh's 12-yarder: Veltkamp gets A-gap heat, throws off his back foot, and Dijon Johnson (No. 27) high-points the underthrown ball. Coleman is on the breakup. Return of a yard.

The FAU scores we sat are why the defense can look sloppy without an All-22. Ethan Ervin (No. 21) 1-yard dive at 13:54 of the second — heavy, A-gap, Florida stacked in the phone booth and still lost the plane. Veltkamp 7-yard scramble at 6:50, 3rd-and-goal — pressure off his left, he flushes, he dives the pylon. That is lost contain, not a designed keep we can prove from this angle. Kelby Valsin (No. 2) 20-yard fade at 1:15 of the third — trips, outside release, stacks Florida No. 6, toe-tap at the back pylon. Veltkamp drops it on the back line. Same family as Stockton's score the other way.

We did not sit Bett's strip. We did not sit a full-drive defensive grade. Highlight D is two interceptions and two touchdowns against. Do not turn that into a season identity.
bullets: Coleman: 3rd-and-10 jump at 12:07 of the first. Drive dies at the Florida 6.
Johnson: back-foot duck after A-gap heat. High-point. Coleman on the breakup.
Ervin 1-yard dive — Florida lost the phone booth.
Veltkamp pylon scramble — lost contain on 3rd-and-goal.
Valsin fade vs Florida No. 6 — stacked, toe-tap, back pylon.
Bett strip and the rest of the defensive snaps are not on this package.

specials.kicker: Specials — the one kick on the tape
specials.body:
Patrick Durkin from 53, 2:06 of the first, 4th-and-4, left hash. Graphic on the screen: 53-YARD ATTEMPT. Clean snap, clean hold (Alec Clark), no block in the window, end-over-end down the middle. Makes it 17–0.

No punt appears on this package. Unused punter is a box fact. It is not a film take.
bullets: Durkin 53: left hash, clean operation, down the middle, 17–0.
No punt on this tape. Do not write the unused punter as On Tape.

keys: Philo: shotgun, ball out on time from a clean pocket; 4th-and-goal empty keep when the edges climb.
Baugh: three TDs, three answers — backside cut, bounce-and-pad, power through the puller.
Clark is the second-back finisher. Not a cameo.
FAU's points on this tape: phone-booth dive, QB pylon scramble, fade vs No. 6.
Not on this tape: Abrams 63, Baugh 61, Bett strip, Micah Jones, Philo's INT. Do not write them as On Tape.
Campbell does not get an All-22 scouting report from an 80-second SEC cut. It gets: finish in the red zone, and do not lose the edge or the fade.

nextWeek.look: Home Saturday 5:30. Red-zone finish showed on this tape. Edge contain and the fade did not. Do not hang a full Campbell scout on highlight clips.
